{{Quote|A Rebel ship has just crash landed on Corellia. I need you to investigate the location and recover any intelligence.|[[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]], to an Imperial operative|<ref name="SWG:AMJ" />}}
A '''YT-2400 light freighter''' was used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
{{Quote|I've analyzed the data you sent. The shuttle's destination was a previously unknown Rebel Hideout on Corellia.|Mara Jade, to an Imperial operative|<ref name="SWG:AMJ" />}}
While members of the Rebel Alliance and other people loyal to their cause celebrated [[Remembrance Day]] in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] on the planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]<ref name="SWG:AMJ" /> in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> the [[YT-2400 light freighter/Legends|YT-2400 light freighter]] was on its way to the [[Hidden Rebel Base|hidden Corellian Rebel Base]] when it crashed onto a beach near Coronet for unknown reasons. None of the passengers and crew members aboard the ship survived the crash.<ref name="SWG:AMJ" />

[[Imperial High Command/Legends|Imperial High Command]] soon learned of the crash and informed [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]], one of the [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hands]], who was attending the [[Empire Day/Legends|Empire Day]] celebrations in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Jade asked loyal Imperial agents participating in the festivities to investigate the crash site and recover any intelligence that he could find on the ship and its passengers. When the agents arrived at the crashed ship, the Imperials identified four victims of the crash. Data found on one of the victims was analyzed and revealed the existence of the previously unknown Rebel Hideout on Corellia to Jade.<ref name="SWG:AMJ" /> Shortly thereafter, the Imperial agents were sent by Jade to infiltrate the Rebel base and free several captured Imperial officers from a detention facility inside.<ref name="SWG:RtsIO">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=faction|Imperial|Rescue the sixth Imperial Officer|Corellia}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
This unnamed YT-2400 freighter appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:AMJ" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The YT-2400 was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 11|Game Update 11]]," published on [[June 23]], [[2009]], and was present in the game during the [[W:c:swg:Empire Day|Empire Day]] events of 2009,<ref name="GU11">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=940830|text=Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 11 Empire Day}}</ref> [[2010]]<ref name="GU17">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1100816|text=Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 17 - Empire Day VII / Remembrance Day VII}}</ref> and [[2011]].<ref name="Hotfix 19.20">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1219548|text=Star Wars Galaxies: Hotfix 19.20}}</ref> Sent by Mara Jade to investigate the crash, Imperial players had to travel to Corellia and search the victims' bodies to find the data.<ref name="SWG:AMJ" /> The quest then continued in the [[Hidden Rebel Base|Corellian Rebel Hideout]].<ref name="SWG:RtsIO" />
